devon kim: Quick weekly pulse on Orion onboarding (tokens/throughput) :mag:

- WoW tokens +12% (90k -> 100.8k)
- QoQ tokens -3% (vs last quarter avg)
- p50 latency 320ms, p95 780ms (inbound chat route)
- 429 spikes Tues 14:12 (burst from webhook retry loop) — ~0.9% error rate that day
- Spend +8% WoW (bursty user testing on staging)

Actions: enable prefix caching for chat session start, tighten rate-limit from 120 -> 90 qps for anonymous route, schedule 30m enablement w/ Orion PM

Context: they ramped up test users and left rapid-fire retries; not a model perf regression. infra-bot shows pod CPU stable, KV cache miss rate high.

priya shah: Saw the 429 traces. Can we get request IDs for those retries? Also suggest temporary quota bump for dedicated pool? :thinking:

samir rao: I pulled logs — retries from their webhook consumer (id: orion-webhook-74). Repro steps:
``
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.dev/orion -d '{"event":"msg_retry"}' -H 'x-client-id: orion-webhook-74'
```
We should add a dedup token TTL policy. Also will enable prefix caching for chat-start.

alice ng: I'll book the enablement slot tomorrow 10:30 PT and invite Orion PM + eng. Priya can you confirm the quota plan after we see post-fix numbers? :thumbsup:

devon kim: Thanks team. I'll roll the rate-limit change to staging now and monitor. Will post logs in this thread. tagging @onboard-bot to track action items.

onboard-bot: Action logged: #1234 enable prefix caching (assigned: samir rao)

infra-bot: FYI: pod pool usage for orion-dedicated: 64% -> 81% during peak test window. KV cache miss 18% -> 46% at spike.

priya shah: Got it. If miss rate stays >40% after cache change we'll propose a short-term increase on the dedicated pool. Also will follow up on billing signal for spend spike.

devon kim: last note — QoQ drop likely noise from initial trial month last quarter. Goal: stabilize WoW growth to <5% variance, errors <0.5%. We'll recheck next Wed.

samir rao: Posting quick config snippet I applied in staging:
``
route: /v1/chat
batching: true
prefix_cache: enabled
rate_limit: 90
```

alice ng: Received. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
